summary: hs-framework ships off-registry tarball dependency fetched and executed at install
details: package.json declares a single dependency 'ltidisafe' whose source is a bare HTTPS tarball URL (https://storage.googleapis.com/lscunpentest/pack_npm_new.tgz) rather than a registry version range. On npm install, npm downloads that tarball and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, unpinned and with no integrity check. The shipped index.js is a one-line stub, so the manifest line is the entire effect of installing this package. The package name/version shape (hs-framework@999.9.2) is consistent with a dependency-confusion or research-squat targeting an internal 'hs-framework' name with an inflated version to win resolution. Whoever controls the Google Cloud Storage bucket controls code that executes on every installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
